trap-triples.notes: RIGOR (reported, not fixed): VERIFIED CORRECT and worth propagating - the Markov weight given here, w_lambda = dim_q(V_lambda).dim(S_lambda)/dim_q(V^{(x)n}), sums to 1 EXACTLY over lambda, because V^{(x)n} = (+)_lambda V_lambda (x) S_lambda makes the numerators add to the denominator. At n = 2 this is ([3]_q + 1)/[2]_q^2 = 1 identically (since [2]_q^2 = q^2+2+q^{-2} = [3]_q + 1). This is the CORRECT normalisation, and it is the concrete fix for clause (4) of thm:em-spectral-completeness, which instead writes w_+- = (dim_q V_+-)^2/[2]_q! and consequently does not sum to 1 at q != 1.
